name: Pigment yellow 150
description: Pigment Yellow 150 (CAS 68511-62-6 ) is a high-performance nickel complex azo pigment delivering a clean, greenish-yellow hue with exceptional lightfastness and heat stability. It is positioned at the premium end of the yellow pigment market. Durability under processing stress and outdoor exposure are primary sourcing criteria for this material. In industrial and automotive coatings, it provides long-term color retention in exterior finishes where UV resistance is a hard specification requirement. Plastics processors use it in polyolefins and engineering polymers where processing temperatures demand a pigment that resists thermal degradation without color shift. This ensures the final product maintains its aesthetic integrity during manufacturing. Printing ink formulators select it for packaging gravure and offset inks requiring bright, reproducible yellow tones with strong bleed resistance. It is highly valued for its performance in high-speed printing environments. Textile and paper applications benefit from its compatibility with aqueous dispersion systems. Consistent shade depth across production batches is a key quality control parameter for these specific industrial sectors. The product is supplied as a dry powder, typically in press cake or flush paste form for ink and coating applications. Standard grades are available for plastics, coatings, and printing inks with tailored particle size distribution. Dispersibility is optimized per end-use to ensure seamless integration into various chemical formulations. Technical-grade material is the prevailing market form for most industrial buyers and distributors. Some suppliers also offer pre-dispersed concentrates for direct formulation use in specialized manufacturing.
